description.value: Sushi Yamato is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, offering both dine-in and takeout service with delivery available through DoorDash. The restaurant accepts credit and debit cards and sits in a dense urban neighbourhood close to the Stanley Park Seawall and other popular cycling routes. An OSM check in April 2026 confirms it remains open.
